plan.purpose: One bounded supervised test of under-optimized actual daiminkan positives; retain original eight-epoch failure

shared.initialState: Identical parent model tensors, all AdamW internal parameter steps/moments, NumPy and CPU Torch RNG; reset only phase schedule/report/best-state counters
shared.data: All original fixed 3p train and validation games and true complete legal-candidate labels; no test

candidateSelection.pool: All eight original 3p epochs plus both epochs from each of the two completed followup arms
candidateSelection.reference: Minimum natural validation NLL across the fixed complete 12-checkpoint pool
candidateSelection.eligibility: All original numerical policy gates unchanged against the global reference; additionally all numerical policy gates against the fixed parent epoch-8 anchor
candidateSelection.ranking: Original mean supported rare exact recall, then lower natural NLL, then original/control/label2 phase order and earlier phase epoch
candidateSelection.fourPlayer: Original eight-epoch run, original selection policy unchanged

plan.stopRule: Exactly two full epochs per arm; no third arm, extra epoch, weight grid, threshold postprocessing, candidate filtering or test-driven tuning. If no eligible checkpoint remains, retain the failed result and report limits; do not relabel it as accepted. Fewer than ten daiminkan predictions never establish success on that action.

binding.gate: Complete eight-epoch validation-only run; zero eligible epochs; minimum natural validation NLL anchor

diagnostic.scope: All offered daiminkan windows from the fixed train and validation partitions, including forced windows; no test access

train.marginHistogramConvention: Left-inclusive bins; first/last extend to negative/positive infinity
train.exampleSelection: Smallest SHA256(gameId:original sample index), independent of score; not a prevalence sample

metrics.opportunityScope: Choice windows only (at least two legal candidates). Action types collapse red-tile and consumed-tile choices; exact scores compare complete candidate indices. diagnostic.batchingNote: Only offered windows are inferred; batch shapes differ from full validation. Full-validation selection metrics stay authoritative and any prediction differences are reported.

record.reason: Prior sessions and training processes no longer exist; logs stopped before eight epochs

protection.scope: Read-only refresh of protected input hashes, repository HEAD/status and installed policy resources/signature

pilotGates.rareGainInterpretation: Report per-action, any-action and all-action outcomes; the plan does not specify any versus all. No claim that any weighted arm passed all gates.

centering.purpose: Public train/validation numerical centering ablation; not a deployment recommendation

4p-lr0.0001.reason: Lower .0003 already underperformed .001 in the completed 4p pilot; stop the less promising follow-up to release GPU for full training. Partial output is not an evaluated result.

benchmark.scope: Synthetic ActionPrototype wire frames through real browser/core; real model weights and AdviceWorker; no WebKit or network latency.
